title: Nvidia launches its OpenShell Reference Architecture, a framework to secure, monitor, and govern AI agents, and partners with Canonical, AWS, BBVA, and others (Thomas Claburn/The Register)
summary: Thomas Claburn / The Register: Nvidia launches its OpenShell Reference Architecture, a framework to secure, monitor, and govern AI agents, and partners with Canonical, AWS, BBVA, and others — Nvidia has proposed a new way to keep corporate AI agents in line. — Nvidia on Wednesday introduced its OpenShell Reference Architecture.
